25.description: Saskatoon City Council overturned a previous denial, allowing the Hellenic (Greek) Community to raise the Greek flag and receive a proclamation. This decision sets a precedent for future similar requests.

chips.text: The Hellenic (Greek) Community of Saskatoon and other countries seeking flag raisings.
Decision sets precedent for future flag raising and proclamation requests from other countries.

24.description: The committee recommends repealing ten outdated bylaws, some dating back to the 1920s, that are no longer enforced, in preparation for a provincial requirement to post all active bylaws online.

27.description: Saskatoon is expanding homelessness services for summer and winter, including new washroom and shower facilities at Comfy, and drop-in centers. Federal funds covered new infrastructure, but city funding is still needed for some services.

chips.text: Councillor Tuman raised concerns about safety and community impact at Comfy and 325 Avenue C South.
Homeless individuals will access 24/7 washrooms at Comfy and drop-ins at 325 Avenue C South.
Winter drop-in facility locations are still undetermined, with no firm timeline for resolution.
Provincial $3 million annually funds service providers directly, not the city.

22.description: Saskatoon City Council rescinded a previous direction to implement a Priority Based Budgeting tool for the 2027 budget cycle, also removing associated greenhouse gas reporting requirements.

13.description: Mayor Clark completed the Bloomberg Harvard City Leadership Initiative, a year-long program equipping mayors to address local challenges like affordability, community safety, and homelessness, aiming to improve outcomes for Saskatoon residents.

chips.text: Bloomberg Harvard partners visited Saskatoon to engage council, staff, and community partners.

28.description: The Meewasin Valley Authority seeks city collaboration to redevelop its property at 402 Third Avenue South in downtown Saskatoon, aiming for a visitor center, new offices, and private uses.

chips.text: Administration clarified referral implies no initial funding or land contributions from the city.
The current building at 402 Third Avenue South provides no public benefit.

19.description: Council received a procedural report detailing attendance and departures during an In Camera meeting.
